events.title: Figure Drawing Workshop [29]
events.address: 200 N Arthur Ashe Boulevard, Richmond, VA 23220
events.description: One-session workshop. Explore drawings of the human form by other artists, then work from a live model to create expressive portraits in charcoal and pencil. Instructor: Amy Smith. Prerequisite: basic drawing skills.

events.title: Queer Life Drawing
events.description: Queer Life Drawing at Gold Lion Community Cafe, hosted by RVA Thriving Artists. Figure drawing with live queer-identified models.

events.title: Nude Figure Drawing: Halloween Edition!
events.description: Long-pose nude figure drawing session with a single partially costumed model, Halloween themed. 18+ only, valid photo ID required. Tickets must be bought in advance, are nonrefundable, and there is no late entry after the 8:00 pm start. This is the last session of 2026 before the winter break.
